items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came down to the club, and brought all the musicians. We met them, talked to them.

ctx.x: Did I read somewhere that Ellington came through?
Yeah, Ellington came down there. He came down to the club, and brought all the musicians. We met them, talked to them. Russell Procope...
The band played an engagement there?
